description: This file defines a class PlainTextErrorRenderer that extends AbstractErrorRenderer. It provides functionality to render exceptions as plain text, including error details and, optionally, previous error traces. It is part of the Slim Framework's error handling system, specifically for rendering errors in plain text format.

classes.name: PlainTextErrorRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class that outputs error information as plain text, including error type, message, file, line, and stack trace, with optional details of previous exceptions.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the throwable exception and returns a formatted plain text string representing the error details. If detailed display is enabled, it includes the entire trace and previous errors.

methods.name: formatExceptionFragment
methods.description: Formats a single Throwable into a string with its class, code, message, file, line, and trace information.
